system.one_liner: Instance-specific test-time training for speech editing in the wild: per utterance, the duration predictor and then the spectrogram denoiser are fine-tuned with extra random masks.

content.variant_note: the model stack of (a) with two dashed zoom insets (variance adaptor, DiT-style denoiser block), then two objective graphs (b, c) for the two test-time-training stages
content.argues: Masking unedited regions at test time gives each utterance its own supervision, so the duration predictor and the spectrogram denoiser can be adapted to it while the phoneme classifier stays frozen.
content.subject: A speech-editing model with zoomed internals, and the masked inputs and losses of its two test-time-training stages.

elements.name: Phoneme y
elements.role: the phoneme sequence of the text to be spoken
elements.drawn_as: italic y under the stack with an arrow up

elements.name: Phoneme Encoder
elements.role: turns the phoneme sequence into D-dimensional representations e_y (paper text)
elements.drawn_as: white box at the bottom of the stack

elements.name: Variance Adaptor
elements.role: predicts duration and pitch of the masked regions and aligns e_y to the target length (paper text)
elements.drawn_as: pale-peach box, opened by a dashed wedge into a peach inset at the left

elements.name: Duration Predictor / Pitch Predictor / LR
elements.role: parts of the variance adaptor; LR is the length regulator (caption)
elements.drawn_as: peach boxes and a circled LR in the left inset, with a plus node and the masked inputs e_dur and e_pitch

elements.name: Spectrogram Denoiser
elements.role: predicts the clean mel-spectrogram x0 from the noisy x_t, the aligned representation e_t and the condition c at timestep t (paper text)
elements.drawn_as: green rounded box, opened by a dashed wedge into a green inset at the right

elements.name: DiT-style block (Linear, LN, Scale, MHSA, Scale/Shift, MLP, × N)
elements.role: inside of the denoiser: a Diffusion Transformer block with scale and shift modulation that replaces a WaveNet (paper text)
elements.drawn_as: column of small boxes in the green inset with a dotted × N frame, residual lines and α, λ, β symbols

elements.name: concat(x_t, e_t + c), t
elements.role: inputs of the denoiser block: the concatenation and the timestep
elements.drawn_as: serif formula under the green inset with arrows up

elements.name: Duration Predictor (with flame)
elements.role: the module fine-tuned in the first TTT stage
elements.drawn_as: peach rounded box with a flame icon

elements.name: Predicted Duration / Target Duration
elements.role: predicted and target phoneme durations that the duration losses compare; M is the length of the edit mask (caption)
elements.drawn_as: two number lists [5 7] 3 3 4 5 and [M] 3 3 4 5, each with a bent arrow to the loss symbols

elements.name: L_dur^(p), L_dur^(m), L_dur^(s)
elements.role: phoneme-level, mask-level and sentence-level duration losses (paper text)
elements.drawn_as: three loss symbols between two bent arrows at the top of (b)

elements.name: Embedding / Masking for TTT
elements.role: random masking of duration embeddings outside the edit region to make test-time-training inputs
elements.drawn_as: two white labelled boxes in a column with cell strips: a strip with red outlines (Mask(Edit)) and a strip with red and yellow outlines (Mask(Edit) Mask(TTT))

elements.name: Duration Embedding / Phoneme Embedding
elements.role: the masked duration embedding and the phoneme embedding, added before the duration predictor
elements.drawn_as: a strip of grey and white cells with red and yellow outlines and a strip of peach cells, joined by a circled plus

elements.name: Masked Mel Spectrogram / Masking for TTT
elements.role: random masking of mel-spectrogram regions outside the inference mask to make test-time-training inputs
elements.drawn_as: mel strip with a red Mask (Edit) box, a white Masking for TTT box, then a mel strip with red Mask (Edit) and yellow Mask (TTT) boxes

elements.name: Spectrogram Denoiser (with flame)
elements.role: the module fine-tuned in the second TTT stage by reconstruction losses on the newly masked regions
elements.drawn_as: green rounded box with a flame icon

elements.name: Phoneme Classifier
elements.role: pretrained classifier whose cross-entropy against the aligned phonemes keeps the speech intelligible (paper text)
elements.drawn_as: peach box with a snowflake icon

elements.name: L_ce^(m); L_diff^(n), L_ssim^(n); y_align
elements.role: classification loss against the aligned phoneme sequence y_align; reconstruction losses on the masked regions
elements.drawn_as: loss symbols at the ends of straight arrows and of two long curved arrows at the right of (c)

Red boxes indicate edit regions, and yellow boxes represent randomly masked regions for TTT.
TTT is applied to the duration predictor, a key module that predicts the durations within the edited region

summary: The paper proposes instance-specific test-time training (TTT) for speech editing in the wild: for each utterance, the duration predictor and then the spectrogram denoiser are fine-tuned with extra random masks outside the edited region. Figure 1 has three lettered panels. (a) shows the model (phoneme encoder, variance adaptor, spectrogram denoiser) as a bottom-up stack, with dashed zoom insets opening the variance adaptor and a DiT-style denoiser block. (b) shows TTT of the duration predictor: edit and random masks on duration embeddings, predicted against target durations and three duration losses. (c) shows TTT of the denoiser on masked mel-spectrograms with reconstruction losses and a frozen phoneme classifier. Flame and snowflake icons mark updated and frozen modules; red and yellow boxes mark edit and TTT masks.
summary_zh: 论文提出面向真实场景语音编辑的实例级测试时训练：对每条语音先后微调时长预测器和频谱去噪器。图分 (a)(b)(c) 三栏：模型结构并用虚线放大两个模块，两个 TTT 阶段的掩码与损失；火焰/雪花图标标可更新与冻结模块。
